product_metadata.title: ME.FAN Silicone Cup Lids - Circle Cup Cover [5 Set] Anti-dust Airtight Seal Mug Cover - Hot Cup Lids/Spoon Holder - Silicone Drink Bowl Lids Bright Colors
features: COLOURFUL & SPOON HOLDER DESIGN: You will get 5 different circle cup lids. Perfect for party and family use, one person a color, can clearly distinguish their own use of the cup. Added the spoon holder on the top of lid, give your loved spoon a home.
HEALTHY MATERIALS: All Silicone Cup Lids are made of food grade silicone. No small, durable and reusable. Simply wash it with your hands or throw it into the dishwasher.
DIMENSION & TEMP RANGE: Diameter 3.9 inches; Suitable for all types of cups with a diameter of less than 3.9 inches. TEMPERATURE: -40~480 F. Can be used in refrigerator and microwave.
AIRTIGHT & KEEP HOT CUP LIDS: Seals tight on all smooth rims like cups, mugs and glasses, prevent from dust, airtight and leak proof. Keeping your coffee or tea hot compared to before.
PACKAGE INCLUDED: 5 x silicone cup covers
